## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Egilsstaðir, Iceland. It starts at Urriðavatn.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Vök Baths has the first floating pools and certified drinkable hot spring water in Iceland.
>
> Vök hot springs supply all the hot water to the surrounding area. Melt your cares away in the sauna, pools, and cold tunnels in the blissful remoteness of Iceland.
>
> Have a spring water tisane brew and locally sourced tasters and treats while enjoying the surroundings.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €63.34. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 54 ratings and 33 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
